```lean
theorem lg_target {C : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] {R : CategoryTheory.Functor Cᵒᵖ RingCat} {M₁ M₂ : PresheafOfModules R} (f : M₁ ⟶ M₂) [CategoryTheory.Epi f] (X : Cᵒᵖ) : CategoryTheory.Epi (f.app X) := by
  apply CategoryTheory.Epi.ofSurjective
  apply Function.surjective_of_right_inverse
  use (f.app X).rightInverse
  constructor
  · rw CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id_app
  · rw CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp_app
    rw CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id_app
    rw CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp_app
    rw CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id_app
    exact rfl
```
